mapper.insert: INSERT INTO admin_account (admin_id, admin_role, status, username, password_hash, created_at, deleted_at) VALUES (UUID_TO_BIN(#{adminId}), #{role}, #{status}, #{username}, #{passwordHash}, #{createdAt}, #{deletedAt}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE admin_role = VALUES(admin_role), status = VALUES(status), username = VALUES(username), password_hash = VALUES(password_hash), deleted_at = VALUES(deleted_at)

insert into admin_profile (admin_id, employee_no, name, phone, email) values (uuid_to_bin(#{adminId}), #{employeeNo}, #{name}, #{phone}, #{email}) on duplicate key update name = values(name), phone = values(phone), email = values(email)
mapper.sql: SELECT BIN_TO_UUID(aa.admin_id) AS admin_id, aa.admin_role, aa.status, aa.username, aa.password_hash, aa.deleted_at, aa.created_at, ap.employee_no, ap.name, ap.phone, ap.email FROM admin_account aa LEFT JOIN admin_profile ap ON aa.admin_id = ap.admin_id
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM admin_account WHERE admin_id = UUID_TO_BIN(#{adminId})
DELETE FROM admin_profile WHERE admin_id = UUID_TO_BIN(#{adminId})
